heard: Roots go deep in the promised land Where the shadows of ancestors stand Caleb, son of Hezron, strong His lineage is the song we sing Zubah bore the sons of light Yeshu, Shobab, and Ardontai But when she died, he found new grace Ephrath bore the hurl who has her place Macabre, the sons of the line Shiver and tear and all are thine Through the concubine the blood flows On in the genealogy of children
